start.title: [TODO:ja] A Hidden Wound
start.text:
[TODO:ja] Beneath your armor, the leprosy spreads.
A young Israelite servant whispers of a prophet.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ja] Pride keeps your wound hidden.
[TODO:ja] Silence will not heal you.
[TODO:ja] Wisdom can come from the small.

curse_consequence.title: [TODO:ja] Soften Your Heart
curse_consequence.text:
[TODO:ja] Her words are not a threat.
They may be the only door open to you.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ja] You set down your pride and listen.

hide_consequence.title: [TODO:ja] No More Hiding
hide_consequence.text:
[TODO:ja] The mark grows beneath your armor.
Only truth can lead to healing.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ja] You turn to her quiet voice.

journey.title: [TODO:ja] Letters and Gold
journey.text:
[TODO:ja] The king sends silver, gold, and a letter.
The road to Israel waits.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ja] No king holds this gift.
[TODO:ja] The Lord works through His servant.

king_consequence.title: [TODO:ja] Not by Royal Hand
king_consequence.text:
[TODO:ja] Israel's king tears his robe in fear.
The prophet sends word: come to him.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ja] You turn the chariot toward Elisha.

arrival.title: [TODO:ja] A Closed Door
arrival.text:
[TODO:ja] Your chariot waits at the prophet's house.
Elisha does not come out.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ja] Stillness opens the heart.
[TODO:ja] Healing is not seized.
[TODO:ja] Grace is not bought.

force_consequence.title: [TODO:ja] Lower Your Sword
force_consequence.text:
[TODO:ja] Strength will not heal your skin.
Wait, and listen.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ja] You step back from the door.

gold_consequence.title: [TODO:ja] Treasures Will Not Cleanse
gold_consequence.text:
[TODO:ja] Your silver cannot reach the wound.
The prophet asks no payment.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ja] You gather the coins back in.

instruction.title: [TODO:ja] Wash Seven Times
instruction.text:
[TODO:ja] The messenger speaks for the prophet.
"Wash in the Jordan and be clean."

choices.text: [TODO:ja] Refuse — the rivers at home are better
choices.feedback: [TODO:ja] Pride blinds you to mercy.
[TODO:ja] God does not need a stage.
[TODO:ja] Humble counsel softens stone.

refuse_consequence.title: [TODO:ja] If It Were a Great Thing
refuse_consequence.text:
[TODO:ja] Your servants whisper at your side.
"If he had asked something hard, would you not do it?"

choices.feedback: [TODO:ja] Their words land deep.

ceremony_consequence.title: [TODO:ja] Lay Down the Show
ceremony_consequence.text:
[TODO:ja] There is no parade, no fire, no chant.
Only muddy water and obedience.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ja] You let go of the spectacle.

jordan.title: [TODO:ja] Into the Brown Water
jordan.text:
[TODO:ja] The Jordan flows slow and muddy.
You step in, armor laid aside.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ja] Half-faith leaves you unchanged.
[TODO:ja] Each dip drowns a piece of pride.

once_consequence.title: [TODO:ja] Finish What He Said
once_consequence.text:
[TODO:ja] His word was seven, not one.
Return into the water.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ja] You sink beneath the current again.

healed.title: [TODO:ja] Skin Like a Child
healed.text:
[TODO:ja] You rise from the water clean.
"Now I know the God of Israel is true."
